description: Get ready-to-paste code for one Nodo icon: inline SVG, a React or Vue component import, or an SVG sprite reference. The "linear" style is free (MIT); the other styles are Nodo Icons Pro.

color.description: Any CSS color. Default inherits the text color.

name.description: Exact icon name from search_icons, e.g. "credit-card".

strokeWidth.description: Only for stroke styles. Default depends on the style (Linear 1.5).

name: get_icon
